details.availability: Public annotation pipeline, fine-tuning and evaluation code; the training data and checkpoint are on the Hub and the FuncPred test split is on Google Drive.

code.basis: repository LICENSE header; not a weights/data license

name: AutoGUI code
notes: Official AutoGUI code. autogui_anno/ is a self-contained reimplementation of the paper's web and mobile annotation pipeline: it gathers screenshots and accessibility trees, rejects unpredictable elements, has an OpenAI-compatible LLM describe each element's function from before/after accessibility-tree changes, verifies descriptions by re-grounding them, and composes grounding tasks at several image scales; web collection uses Playwright. finetune/ trains Qwen-VL-Chat with LoRA on the released AutoGUI training data, and the adapted lmms_eval package runs FuncPred, ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, RefExp, MOTIF and VisualWebBench grounding tasks for models the README lists, including Qwen-VL-Chat, Qwen2-VL, LLaVA, CogAgent, Ferret-UI, UGround and OS-Atlas. The README links the 702K training set on the Hub, a 2K FuncPred test split on Google Drive and an AutoGUI-Qwen checkpoint. The arXiv abstract points to autogui-project.github.io, the repository's homepage, which links this code; that page's own Paper link points to an unrelated arXiv ID. The README's clone command uses the former BraveGroup/AutoGUI address. Code was read, not run.
summary: AutoGUI's functionality-annotation pipeline (collect, reject, annotate from accessibility-tree changes, verify, generate tasks), with Qwen-VL LoRA fine-tuning and lmms-eval-based grounding evaluation.
